scenes.narration: Willpower is treated as a character trait. Research treats it as a resource, and resources run out.
Across a day, self control measurably declines. The evening version of you is negotiating with less fuel than the morning one.
This is why decisions made at night so often contradict decisions made at breakfast.
Environment beats effort every time. People who appear disciplined usually have fewer temptations within reach.
That is the entire trick. Make the good option the default and the bad option require steps.
You are not weak. You are fighting a system that was never designed for constant resistance.
